- Or we can route an authenticated IRS transcript request but that will take longer.

Hi Angela — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the W-8BEN-E.

Quick path to unblock: procurement can provisionally create a PO if we receive one of the following evidences:
1) notarized trustee affidavit (signed & notarized) naming the entity and confirming EIN; or
2) bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the EIN and account holder; or
3) redacted Articles of Organization or a comparable government registration document that contains the EIN.

Option 1 or 3 will get us across compliance quicker. If you send the notarized affidavit + the redacted Articles PDF, we'll route it to Finance for conditional PO issuance.

Please include a short sentence in the affidavit confirming the legal name variation (if any) between the payee and the DBA/beneficial owner so we can map records correctly.

Cc'ing Kimberly in Finance for approvals and Marissa from Legal for any signatory checks.

Thanks — aim to get you a provisional PO within 24-48 hours after we receive the docs.

Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
